summary.zh: 有二手整理稱，學生原本等靈車繞廣場以便送別，後來得知靈車已從別處離開，情緒因此激動；UPI 則引新華社稱約百萬人沿街看靈車經過。路線細節未能以一手資料確認，標為無法確認。
summary.en: A secondary account says students waited for the hearse to circle the Square but it left another way; UPI (citing Xinhua) said about a million lined the streets. Route details unconfirmed.

sources.title: Hu Yaobang's Funeral (excerpts NYT 1989-04-22 + reconstruction)
